comment: The logo fetch's time bounds and its one journal line (D-LOGO-16, R30e; R30c), run by BOTH
tests/Model.test.js and tests/test_logo_run.py. A number implemented in two languages gets one
`logoMs` is one logo's whole-fetch deadline: the helper's LOGO_DEADLINE (seconds,
05-ipc-logos.py) and Model.LOGO_DEADLINE_MS. `runMs` is the run's: LOGO_RUN_DEADLINE
(06-failed.py) and Model.LOGO_RUN_DEADLINE_MS; after it the run starts no fetch, so it ends one
logo deadline later at the latest. `watchdogMs` is the shell's outer bound,
`summaryFields` are the names of the summary's fields that Model.logoSummaryNotice reads: the
python side runs the real verb and finds each of them in what it prints, of the type given, so
the join between the helper's line and the shell's reading of it is made by a call and not by
a name (engineering rule 13). `notices` are summary lines and the line the shell writes for
each ("" for none); node runs them.
